_about: Tunables for scripts/security/dast_auth_sweep.py. Every floor is a MINIMUM with headroom under a value measured against an unchanged app; a count drifting BELOW a floor exits 2 (could not measure), never 0. Raise a floor when the real number grows; NEVER lower one to make a run pass.

_provenance.min_route_rows_examined: measured 105 on 2026-07-31 against 2fd1ad8a; re-measured 108 on 2026-09-05 against c57903c2
_provenance.min_gated_http_rows: measured 99 on 2026-07-31 against 2fd1ad8a; re-measured 102 on 2026-09-05 against c57903c2
_provenance.min_negative_probes: measured 198 on 2026-07-31 against 2fd1ad8a; re-measured 204 on 2026-09-05 against c57903c2
_provenance.min_get_rows_reached: measured 46 on 2026-07-31 against 2fd1ad8a; re-measured 47 on 2026-09-05 against c57903c2
_provenance.min_bfla_probes: measured 19 on 2026-07-31 against 2fd1ad8a; re-measured 19 on 2026-09-05 against c57903c2
_provenance.min_write_rows_reached: measured 47 of 55 gated non-GET rows on 2026-09-05 against c57903c2; the 8 that refused the administrator are the action-scoped step-up rows in unreachable_allowlist below
_provenance.min_write_bfla_probes: measured 43 write BFLA candidate rows, all 43 refused, on 2026-09-05 against c57903c2
_provenance._canary_floor_units: The canary floors below are compared against negative_non_401, bfla_violations and write_bfla_violations, which count PROBES, not rows. The open-auth canary sends 2 probes per gated row, so its finding count is roughly twice the row count -- do not re-derive a floor from a row number.
_provenance.open-auth_min_negative_findings: measured 196 failing PROBES (98 of 99 gated rows x 2 probes; the holdout is the mTLS-only GET /service/identity) on 2026-07-31 against 2fd1ad8a
_provenance.bfla_min_violations: measured 19 failing PROBES (all 19 GET BFLA candidates) on 2026-07-31 against 2fd1ad8a
_provenance.bfla_min_write_violations: measured 40 failing PROBES of 43 write BFLA candidates on 2026-09-05 against c57903c2; the 3 that still refused the over-granted identity are the action-scoped step-up rows under /users/{user_id}
_provenance.max_write_session_rebuilds: measured 1 on 2026-09-05 against c57903c2 -- POST /auth/logout answers a valid administrator token 200 and revokes the session
